categories.name: Quote Builder
categories.purpose: Quote editor with live commercial calculations and a client-facing proposal preview
categories.target_audience: Sales coordinator / account executive at a small service business
categories.ux_direction: A two-pane document workspace: editable commercial line items on the left, a polished quote preview on the right. Treat the quote document—not a dashboard—as the primary workspace.
categories.primary_data_model: Quote, QuoteLine, Customer, ProductOrService, TaxRule, Discount, QuoteStatus, PaymentTerm
categories.core_user_flows: Select a customer; edit reference and validity; add, edit and remove line items; calculate subtotal, percentage discount, VAT and total; save a local draft; mark ready to issue; print the preview.
categories.implementation_notes: Use integer minor currency units in a production implementation. Keep tax rates configurable by jurisdiction and quote date. Validate quantities and rates as non-negative. Do not imply tax or legal advice. The mockup uses EUR and indicative Austrian VAT options.
categories.agent_implementation_brief: Create a responsive quote editor with live totals and a printable proposal view. Persist locally for the demo; production should have customer/product selectors, immutable issued snapshots, version history, quote acceptance and PDF rendering.

categories.name: Helpdesk
categories.purpose: Shared support inbox for triaging customer questions, replying in context and managing ticket ownership and status.
categories.ux_direction: Three-pane support inbox: compact navigation rail, searchable ticket queue, central email-style conversation thread and ticket properties panel. The conversation is the primary canvas.
categories.primary_data_model: Ticket, Customer, Message, Assignee, Priority, Status, Tag, OrderReference
categories.core_user_flows: Search tickets; filter by status; open a ticket; inspect customer context; change priority, assignee and status; add a reply; resolve or snooze the ticket.
categories.implementation_notes: Use synthetic customers and example.test email addresses only. Keep message history append-only. In production, enforce tenant scoping, role-based access, PII retention controls, safe attachment handling and an auditable status history.
categories.agent_implementation_brief: Implement a three-pane helpdesk with seeded tickets, thread rendering, search/filter, property updates and reply composition. Add domain tests for status transitions, assignment and message ordering.

categories.name: Shipments
categories.purpose: Shipment control tower that tracks parcel movement, milestones, carrier exceptions and estimated delivery.
categories.target_audience: Small fulfilment team or logistics coordinator
categories.ux_direction: Operations control tower: shipment table on the left, selected shipment route and milestone history on the right. Prioritise scan status and exceptions over a generic analytics dashboard.
categories.primary_data_model: Shipment, Parcel, Carrier, Route, TrackingEvent, DeliveryEstimate, Exception, Recipient
categories.core_user_flows: Search shipments; filter by state; select a shipment; inspect tracking milestones; record a demo scan; flag an exception; create a draft shipment.
categories.implementation_notes: Tracking map is an illustrative route, not live geolocation. Production integrations should normalize carrier events, deduplicate webhook deliveries, preserve raw event payloads and distinguish estimated from confirmed delivery times.
categories.agent_implementation_brief: Build a local shipment control tower with carrier-neutral records, event timeline and exception workflow. Seed realistic but synthetic shipments; test event ordering, status mapping and duplicate scan handling.

categories.name: Trip Planner
categories.purpose: Personal itinerary planner combining day-by-day stops, booking references and a practical packing checklist.
categories.target_audience: Independent travellers, couples or small groups
categories.ux_direction: Travel journal / itinerary composition: trip collection on the left, scenic trip header and day tabs in the centre, essentials and packing list in a side rail. The day timeline is the core interaction.
categories.primary_data_model: Trip, Day, Stop, Place, Booking, Traveller, PackingItem, Note
categories.core_user_flows: Switch trip days; inspect chronological stops; add and reorder stops by time; tick packing items; inspect bookings and travel notes.
categories.implementation_notes: No live booking or map API is required. Show local demo data and make travel times/forecasts explicitly illustrative. Production should preserve time zones per stop and support offline access and collaborative editing.
categories.agent_implementation_brief: Implement a multi-day itinerary with editable stops, local packing checklist and booking notes. Add tests for date ordering, stop ordering and checklist persistence.

categories.name: Reservations
categories.purpose: Restaurant reservation and table-management tool for planning a service, seating guests and reviewing the upcoming book.
categories.ux_direction: Restaurant floor plan is the centre of the application. Clickable tables show capacity and seating state; a right-hand service list shows upcoming bookings. This is a spatial seating workflow, not a calendar dashboard.
categories.primary_data_model: Reservation, Guest, Table, Seating, ServicePeriod, PartySize, ReservationStatus, WaitlistEntry
categories.core_user_flows: Choose a service time; inspect table availability; select a table; review upcoming bookings; add a reservation; clear selection.
categories.implementation_notes: Table availability must be computed from overlapping reservation intervals and seating duration, not just a static status. The mockup is a local single-service simulation with synthetic guests; production should support table combinations, deposits and no-show policies.
categories.agent_implementation_brief: Build an interactive floor plan and reservation list, with time-slot-aware table allocation. Add overlap and capacity tests, including combined tables and walk-in holds.

categories.name: Listings
categories.purpose: Property listing browser for filtering homes by area, property type, price and bedroom count, then inspecting a property and requesting a viewing.
categories.ux_direction: Consumer-facing listing catalogue with a narrow filter rail and image-led property cards. A property detail drawer provides facts and enquiry action. It should look like a listings product, not an agent CRM.
categories.primary_data_model: Property, Address, Listing, MediaAsset, Feature, Price, Enquiry, SavedListing
categories.core_user_flows: Filter by property type, maximum price and bedrooms; inspect listing details; save a home; submit a viewing enquiry.
categories.implementation_notes: All properties and addresses are fictional demo records. Production must distinguish asking price from fees, respect listing publication/expiry state, and apply consent and contact controls to enquiries. Mockup photos are CSS art placeholders.
categories.agent_implementation_brief: Implement a responsive property catalogue, filters, save action and detail/enquiry drawer. Add tests for filter composition, saved-listing state and enquiry validation.

categories.name: Site Diary
categories.purpose: Daily site record for documenting work completed, workforce, progress, weather, issues and deliveries on a construction project.
categories.ux_direction: Digital site notebook with dated entries in a left rail and a report sheet in the main panel. Tabs switch between activity, issues and deliveries. The report itself is the product.
categories.primary_data_model: Project, SiteDiaryEntry, WorkforceRecord, Activity, ProgressUpdate, SiteIssue, Delivery, WeatherObservation, Attachment
categories.core_user_flows: Browse recent reports; create a new daily report; switch report sections; review workforce, completed works, open issues and deliveries.
categories.implementation_notes: This mockup uses sample project data and does not certify site conditions. Production needs timestamped audit history, attachment storage, offline capture, author signatures and report locking after submission.
categories.agent_implementation_brief: Create a daily site diary with report tabs and immutable submitted reports. Test report creation, date handling, permissions and issue ownership. Include photo attachment metadata in the data model.

categories.name: Field Planner
categories.purpose: Farm field and seasonal crop planner for keeping parcel boundaries, crop rotation, field notes and upcoming operations together.
categories.ux_direction: Interactive parcel map as the primary surface, with a right-side field dossier showing crop plan, observations and tasks. The map selects the active parcel; the side panel changes to its agronomic record.
categories.primary_data_model: Farm, Field, Boundary, CropSeason, CropPlan, Variety, FieldTask, FieldObservation, SoilSample, YieldRecord
categories.core_user_flows: Select a parcel; inspect area and crop plan; review field operations; add a task; record a field observation; switch season.
categories.implementation_notes: Map boundaries and agronomic values are fictional. This is planning/admin software, not automated machinery control or agronomic advice. Production should use spatially valid geometries, units, crop-rotation history and field-level permissions.
categories.agent_implementation_brief: Implement a parcel selector with local vector boundaries, crop plan and task/observation workflow. Test field ownership, area units, task assignment and season transitions.

categories.name: Energy Tracker
categories.purpose: Building-level energy usage tracker that compares consumption periods, estimates cost from an indicative tariff and records manual meter readings.
categories.target_audience: Facility manager or small property operator
categories.ux_direction: Energy operations console with a deep-colour consumption headline, period selector, hourly usage chart and end-use breakdown. The chart is the main analytical surface.
categories.primary_data_model: Site, Meter, MeterReading, ConsumptionInterval, Tariff, CostEstimate, EndUseCategory, PeriodComparison
categories.core_user_flows: Switch day/week/month views; switch chart metric between energy and cost; inspect end-use shares; record a manual meter reading.
categories.implementation_notes: Mock data is illustrative and cost is an estimate, not a bill. Production requires unit normalization, meter rollover handling, tariff effective dates, interval aggregation and explicit missing-data treatment.
categories.agent_implementation_brief: Build an energy dashboard with period aggregation, a usage chart and manual meter-reading entry. Test kWh conversion, period boundaries, tariff calculations and invalid readings.

categories.name: SIM Inventory
categories.purpose: SIM and mobile-number inventory for tracking carrier, plan, assignment, lifecycle status and recurring monthly cost.
categories.target_audience: IT administrator or telecom operations coordinator
categories.ux_direction: High-density inventory table as the primary surface, with a SIM profile drawer for assignment and suspend/reactivate actions. This is an asset register, not a subscriber-facing portal.
categories.primary_data_model: SIM, PhoneNumber, ICCID, Carrier, Plan, Assignment, Device, LifecycleStatus, RecurringCharge
categories.core_user_flows: Search by phone number, user or ICCID; filter by lifecycle status; inspect SIM details; change assignment; suspend/reactivate; add inventory record; export CSV.
categories.implementation_notes: Phone numbers and ICCIDs are synthetic reserved-looking demo placeholders, not provisioned numbers. Production should encrypt identifiers, restrict access to telecom metadata, validate carrier provisioning state and log lifecycle actions.
categories.agent_implementation_brief: Create a SIM asset register with searchable inventory, details drawer, assignment and lifecycle controls, plus CSV export. Test unique ICCID constraints, assignment changes, and suspend/reactivate audit events.
